response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.name AS name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId WHERE ds.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points) AS overall_avg FROM per_race) SELECT p.name AS race_name, p.avg_points AS avg_points, p.avg_points - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM per_race p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_points > o.overall_avg

assumptions.assumption: "Clear the 1.0-point threshold" means strictly greater than 1.0 (points > 1.0), not >= 1.0.
Races are grouped by races.name across all years, and the overall average is the unweighted mean of the per-race-name averages.

alternatives.interpretation: Threshold inclusive: keep entries with points >= 1.0.
